function: p. 11-12: CNN detector that estimates the posterior of each transmitted OTFS symbol from the outputs of a message-passing receiver, in LEO satellite grant-free random access.
system: p. 3, 13: 40 single-antenna IoT devices, LEO satellite with 4x4 UPA, OTFS (M,N)=(16,7), S-band, 30 kHz subcarrier spacing, NTN-TDL-D; no RIS.
method: p. 12-13: Complex residual CNN (8 residual blocks), supervised with cross-entropy and Adam on outputs of a non-learned MRF-MP-GAMP-EM receiver; trained on simulated samples.
data_channel: p. 13, 17: Simulated LEO link with NTN-TDL-D power delay profile (3GPP TR 38.811, ref. [20]); 8,000 training, 2,000 validation, 2,000 test samples.
test_conditions: p. 13-15: Training conditions (SNR, Q, activity) not stated; defaults U=40, Q=8, activity 0.1; tests sweep SNR, number of frames Q, device activity, on-grid and off-grid Doppler.
baselines: p. 13: Non-learned two-phase OTFS benchmarks ConvSBL-GAMP+MP, GMMV-AMP+GAMP and Oracle-LMMSE; ablation without CNN (MRF-MP-GAMP); no learned baseline.
metrics: p. 13: Activity error rate (AER) for device identification, normalized MSE (NMSE) of the channel, and symbol error rate (SER).
complexity: p. 11: Order O(QUM^2N^2Na + |A|QM^2NNa + Pbar^3) for the MRF-MP-GAMP stage; no FLOPs, parameters or runtime for the CNN.
q1_support: p. 13: "The power delay profile of TSL follows the NTN-TDL-D [20]"; p. 17: "document TR 38.811, V15.4.0, 3GPP"
q2_support: p. 13: "datasets are generated with 8,000 samples for training, 2,000 for validation, and 2,000 for testing" (one dataset split; the paper never states that the CNN is tested on a scenario, Q or activity different from training)
q3_support: p. 13: "The two-phase OTFS scheme is adopted for performance comparison, incorporating three benchmarks" (all non-learned: ConvSBL-GAMP+MP, GMMV-AMP+GAMP, Oracle-LMMSE; the only other curve is the same method without the CNN)
q4_support: p. 11: "the total complexity of the MRF-MP-GAMP algorithm is in the order of" O(QUM^2N^2Na + |A|QM^2NNa + Pbar^3); the CNN cost is not given
q5_support: p. 13: "datasets are generated with 8,000 samples for training" (own simulator; no code or data link and no public dataset anywhere in the paper)
notes: Only the CNN detector (p. 11-12) is learned; device identification, channel estimation and the first symbol estimate come from the non-learned MP/GAMP/EM receiver. Area 4 because the CNN performs OTFS delay-Doppler detection; the satellite setting does not change it. q1: only the power delay profile (and Rician factor 11.707 dB, Table I, p. 13) comes from 3GPP TR 38.811 NTN-TDL-D; the doubly dispersive channel of Eq. (1), p. 4, is the paper's own, so the reviewer should confirm. q4: the complexity order covers the MP stage only, not the CNN. q2: Figs. 6-8 sweep Q and device activity, but the paper does not say the CNN was trained at other values.
